_comments: Lapsed Close Date Digest. Without these nobody can see, or fix, a wrong recipient address in
Explorer, which is the premise the design rests on. Sales Admin maintains recipients; Sales User
can read. Neither role can delete an audience type: those are shipped vocabulary, and a host adds
its own audience row instead of changing these.
Sales Admin can ADD an audience row (CanCreate) and change one (CanUpdate): a new audience or a
different threshold is a row, not a deploy, and MJ has no owner bypass, so without these only
CodeGen's Developer and Integration defaults could do it. Sales Admin still cannot delete one:
the four shipped rows are vocabulary. Do not edit those four; add your own audience row instead.
